viewPath.description: Default views path alias (used when resolving relative view names).

tablePrefix.description: Database table prefix (for future ActiveRecord table name resolution).

reportMissingViews.description: Report missing view templates as problems.

scanPaths.controllers.description: Comma-separated directories to scan for Controller classes (relative to project root).

scanPaths.models.description: Comma-separated directories to scan for Model/Form classes.

scanPaths.views.description: Comma-separated directories to scan for view files.

scanPaths.messages.description: Comma-separated directories to scan for i18n message files.

scanPaths.assets.description: Comma-separated directories to scan for AssetBundle classes.

scanPaths.widgets.description: Comma-separated directories to scan for Widget classes.

scanPaths.commands.description: Comma-separated directories to scan for Console Command classes.

scanPaths.migrations.description: Comma-separated directories to scan for migration files.

scanPaths.config.description: Comma-separated directories to scan for config files (aliases, components, urlManager).

features.i18n.description: Enable i18n category and message key completion.

features.aliases.description: Enable alias (@app, @runtime, etc.) completion and resolution.

features.assets.description: Enable asset bundle (JS/CSS) completion and navigation.

performance.maxScanFiles.description: Maximum files to scan per index build (higher = more complete, slower).

performance.maxFileSizeKb.description: Maximum file size (KB) to parse for indexing.

performance.cacheTtlSeconds.description: Cache TTL in seconds (lower = fresher, higher = faster).

performance.enableOpBudget.description: Enable operation budget to prevent WASM timeout (50ms limit).

advanced.projectType.description: Yii2 project template type (affects default scan paths).

advanced.moduleDetection.description: Automatically detect modules from directory structure.

advanced.urlManagerConfigKeys.description: Comma-separated config keys where urlManager rules are defined.

advanced.customAliases.description: Additional custom aliases as JSON string (e.g., '{"@vendor": "/path/to/vendor"}').

advanced.ignoredPaths.description: Comma-separated paths to ignore during scanning (glob patterns).
